
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ishoulgodo/p/22814726" title="发布于 2026-09-04 16:45">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">go语言中的map,map定义不同的数据类型,循环map,map的无序性</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h4 id="make声明字符串类型的切片">make声明字符串类型的切片</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")
func main()  {
  // make 声明切片，长度是4， 容量是10
  var sliceArr1 = make([]string, 4, 10)
  fmt.Printf("切片：%v", sliceArr1)
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="map的默认值是nil">map的默认值是nil</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapObject = make([]map[string]string,3,3)
	fmt.Println(mapObject[0]== nil)
	// 输出true
} 
</code></pre>
<p>把map[string]string 把它看做是一个对象<br>
map等价于{}对象，[string]string等价于key:value的形式<br>
因为map中读取是obje["key"]，所以key的声明在括号里<br>
整体如下：<br>
{<br>
key:value的形式，key是字符串，value也是字符串<br>
}<br>
make([]map[string]string,3,3)<br>
就等价于<br>
make([]{<br>
key:value的形式，key是字符串，value也是字符串<br>
})</p>
<h4 id="切片定义一个对象数组">切片定义一个对象数组</h4>
<p>要定于对象数组，外层肯定是切片，内层是map<br>
map[string]string =&gt; { key:value }<br>
[]map[string]string =&gt; [{ key:value }]</p>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapObject = make([]map[string]string,2,2)
	fmt.Println(mapObject[0]== nil)
	if mapObject[0] == nil {
		mapObject[0] = make(map[string]string)
		mapObject[0]["name"] = "xiaoming"
		mapObject[0]["age"] = "18"
	}
	if mapObject[1] == nil {
		mapObject[1] = make(map[string]string)
		mapObject[1]["name"] = "xiaohong"
		mapObject[1]["age"] = "19"
	}
	fmt.Println(mapObject)
} 
</code></pre>
<p>[map[age:18 name:xiaoming] map[age:19 name:xiaohong]]</p>
<h4 id="循环map类型的数据">循环map类型的数据</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapObject = make([]map[string]string,2,2)
	if mapObject[0] == nil {
		mapObject[0] = make(map[string]string)
		mapObject[0]["name"] = "xiaoming"
		mapObject[0]["age"] = "18"
	}
	if mapObject[1] == nil {
		mapObject[1] = make(map[string]string)
		mapObject[1]["name"] = "xiaohong"
		mapObject[1]["age"] = "19"
	}
	for _,value := range mapObject {
		for key,valueInItem := range value {
			  fmt.Printf("key：%v, value:%v\n", key, valueInItem)
		}
	}
} 
</code></pre>
<p>key：name, value:xiaoming<br>
key：age, value:18<br>
key：name, value:xiaohong<br>
key：age, value:19</p>
<h4 id="map类型的值定义为切片">map类型的值定义为切片</h4>
<p>map ={}<br>
map[string][]string = {<br>
"key是字符串": [value1,value2]<br>
}</p>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapKeyObjet =make(map[string][]string)
	mapKeyObjet["likeArr"] = []string{"吃饭","睡觉","打豆豆"}
	mapKeyObjet["action"] = []string{"写代码","参加技术讨论"}
	fmt.Println(mapKeyObjet)
} 
</code></pre>
<p>map[action:[写代码 参加技术讨论] likeArr:[吃饭 睡觉 打豆豆]]</p>
<h4 id="循环-map类型的值定义为切片">循环 map类型的值定义为切片</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapKeyObjet =make(map[string][]string)
	mapKeyObjet["likeArr"] = []string{"吃饭","睡觉","打豆豆"}
	mapKeyObjet["action"] = []string{"写代码","参加技术讨论"}
	fmt.Println(mapKeyObjet)

	for key,v := range mapKeyObjet {
		for _,v2 := range v {
			fmt.Printf("key：%v, value:%v\n", key, v2)
		}
	}
} 
</code></pre>
<p>map[action:[写代码 参加技术讨论] likeArr:[吃饭 睡觉 打豆豆]]<br>
key：likeArr, value:吃饭<br>
key：likeArr, value:睡觉<br>
key：likeArr, value:打豆豆<br>
key：action, value:写代码<br>
key：action, value:参加技术讨论</p>
<h4 id="map-也是引用数据类型">map 也是引用数据类型</h4>
<h4 id="值类型和引用类型">值类型和引用类型</h4>
<p>值类型: 改变变量副本值的时候，不会改变变量本身的值<br>
引用类型:改变变量副本值的时候，会改变变量本身的值</p>
<h4 id="引用类型改变变量副本值的时候会改变变量本身的值">引用类型:改变变量副本值的时候，会改变变量本身的值</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapKeyObjet =make(map[string]string)
	mapKeyObjet["name"] = "小王"
	mapKeyObjet["age"] = "18"
	userInfo := mapKeyObjet
  // 改变副本的值，会改变变量本身的值
	userInfo["name"] = "大王"
	mapKeyObjet["age"] = "58"
	fmt.Println(userInfo)
	fmt.Println(mapKeyObjet)
} 
</code></pre>
<p>map[age:58 name:大王]<br>
map[age:58 name:大王]</p>
<h4 id="map的无序性">map的无序性</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")

func main()  {
	var mapObject =make(map[int]int)
	mapObject[1] = 45
	mapObject[5] = 50
	mapObject[3] = 98
	mapObject[4] = 78
	fmt.Println(mapObject)
  for key,value := range mapObject{
		fmt.Println(key,value)
	}
} 
</code></pre>
<p>输出的值是：map[1:45 3:98 4:78 5:50]<br>
1 45<br>
5 50<br>
3 98<br>
4 78<br>
key值的顺序发生变化<br>
每次执行代码，顺序可能都是不一样的哈</p>
<h4 id="map类型让key进行升序然后输出">map类型让key进行升序然后输出</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")
import ("sort")

func main()  {
	var mapObject =make(map[int]int)
	mapObject[1] = 45
	mapObject[5] = 50
	mapObject[3] = 98
	mapObject[4] = 78	
	
	var keySlice []int
	for key,_:= range mapObject{
		// 1.通过循环把map中的key放入切片中去
		keySlice = append(keySlice,key)
	}
	// 2.让key进行升序排序
	sort.Ints(keySlice)
	fmt.Printf("map中的key：%v\n",keySlice)

	for _,value := range keySlice{
		// 3.通过key获取value
		fmt.Printf("key:%d,value:%d\n",value, mapObject[value])
	}
} 
</code></pre>
<h4 id="统计字符串中单词出现的次数">统计字符串中单词出现的次数</h4>
<pre><code>package main
import ("fmt")
import ("strings")
func main()  {
	var str = "how do you do you"
	var strSlice = strings.Split(str, " ")
	// 输出：[how do you do you],转化为数组
	fmt.Println(strSlice)
  // 创建一个map对象，用来保存单词出现的次数
	var strMap = make(map[string]int)
	for _, v := range strSlice {
    //如果出现相同的单词，次数加1
		sreMap[v]++
	}
	fmt.Println(strMap)
} 
</code></pre>
